changelog:
• MySoundLib v1.1.1 Beta 1 release
• macOS: separate downloads for Apple Silicon (arm64) and Intel (x86_64)
• macOS: app data moves to ~/Library/Application Support/MySoundLib (copied automatically, old folder kept as a backup)
• macOS: QuickSearch shortcut is now Option+Shift+F, with a guide to enable Input Monitoring
• macOS: warning when the app is opened straight from the disk image or Downloads
• macOS: more reliable Move to Trash, Reveal in Finder, FFmpeg detection and automatic restart
• Linux: global QuickSearch shortcut on X11 and a --quicksearch command to bind as a system shortcut on Wayland
• Linux: AppImage fixes and Show in File Manager now selects the file
• All platforms: restarting the app (menu, language or storage change) now reliably reopens it
• Scanning: macOS metadata files (._*, .DS_Store) are ignored and accented file names no longer duplicate
• Trim and Replace keeps the original file format (MP3, M4A, FLAC...)
• Conversion: AIFF output support
• The open library is no longer reset after saving Settings
• More of the interface translated to Portuguese, Spanish and Hindi
